verdict.rationale: A live runtime probe confirms Reclaim hosts an official MCP server at mcp.reclaim.ai that correctly implements the OAuth protected-resource flow (401 challenge plus valid oauth-protected-resource metadata with mcp scope), tied to the AI Assistant's 'MCP connectors' feature. This is concrete evidence of a working hosted MCP endpoint rather than just a claim. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the MCP server's tool surface/setup, and independent hands-on reports of connecting an agent to it.
